description: Since the SQLGlot soft fork (#3139), every runtime import resolves through benchbox._vendor (benchbox/_vendor/__init__.py appends the bundled wheel zip to __path__), so uv run --with sqlglot==X installs a PyPI copy that no code under test imports. Discovered while implementing sqlglot-floor-residual-incompat: a probe with --with sqlglot==26.0.0 printed 26.0.0 while the exercised code used the vendored 30.23.0.2, and the retired make tpchavoc-sqlglot-minimum-check gate (--with sqlglot==25.6.0) had been green-but-meaningless since the fork (fixed by PR #3171, which removed it). Nothing prevents the next version-matrix check from repeating the pattern. Smallest fix is a lint-level guard or a short note in the vendoring decision record; do not reintroduce per-version overlays.
